_comment_toolCalling: ON since 2026-10-04 (operator decision). The model may call the eight tools (observe, find_blocks, scan_around, lookup_item, do_task, go_to, do_skill, stop) before deciding, so it looks at the world instead of imagining it: scan_around returns the egocentric terrain grid and every refused/failed call carries failure+hint. Verified live on deepseek-flash: the tool round needs the assistant's reasoning_content replayed and a completion budget big enough for thinking-mode reasoning (both fixed in 513bf33). Requires a provider with native tool calling; the plain intent-JSON exchange remains the fallback when the round is invalid or loops.
